top_signals.title: Price hikes to likely weigh on Japan households from summer onward
top_signals.summary: Elevated crude oil prices, reflecting Middle East turmoil, have driven up procurement and logistics costs for companies. Households have already started to feel the impact.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US chip stocks slide as government borrowing costs hit multiyear highs
top_signals.summary: Fears over inflation and mounting public debt ignite bond sell-off
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: More than 200 victims of Medusa ransomware identified over the last year, CISA says
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and FBI updated an advisory on the group initially released in March 2025 — writing that as of April 2026, Medusa actors have hit more than 500 victims. CISA previously said 300 victims, many of which are in critical infrastructure sectors, were attacked as of 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BHP’s copper pivot is paying off
top_signals.summary: Miner’s pipeline looks increasingly convincing given the red metal’s ubiquitous use
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
